page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor clocked at 3.2 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

This instance type does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring the attachment of external block storage volumes for persistent data. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.c9i.xlarge offers a resource-dense configuration tailored for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. This profile is suitable for batch processing, web serving, microservices, and front-end application servers where consistent CPU performance is prioritized over local storage capacity or high memory density.
